# Superpowers workflow

For each coding task in this workspace, first read `.github/skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md`, then read the relevant skill before acting. These skills provide workflow guidance and do not override higher-priority instructions, the user's request, or repository safety requirements.

Adapt the skills to the capabilities available in this VS Code session. Do not claim to use unavailable subagents or plugin hooks. Use Windows-compatible commands, and do not run bundled scripts or destructive operations without reviewing them and obtaining any required approval.
